name: Gambit

abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Ragin' Cajun
Prowess Buffs now also grant Gambit +[44.72 - 145.01] Critical Damage Rating each.
Additionally, his Flak Jacket is upgraded to allow it to absorb an additional [26,687.8] attack damage before breaking.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Gambit charges his weapons while holding Block, gaining a Kinetic Charge every 0.4 seconds. Kinetic Charges build up more slowly as Gambit accumulates more of them. Max Charges: 10.
Gambit cannot stack additional Kinetic Charges while his personal Prowess buffs are active.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Gambit cashes out, converting his Kinetic Charges to Prowess Buffs, each increasing Special Damage by 30% for 16 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Stun
content: Each Stun Debuff on the Opponent Reduces Regeneration Rate and Combat Power Rate by 40% while active.
All Stun Debuffs currently on the Opponent are Paused for the duration of Gambit's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Medium, Heavy, Special 1 and Special 2 Attacks
content: These attacks utilize a burst of kinetic energy. Striking with them reduces the damage of the Opponent's Passive Degeneration and Direct Damage effects by 100% for 0.2 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Flak Jacket
content: Gambit begins each fight with a Flak Jacket charge, which is lost once Gambit has taken [66,719.5] attack damage. Tech Champions' attack damage counts double for this purpose.
While Flak Jacket is active, Gambit gains +[1,833.33] Armor Rating and incoming Bleed effects suffer -150% Potency.
Against Non-Contact Physical Attacks, the Flak Jacket provides an additional +[1,833.33] Armor Rating and Critical Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If the opponent does not have an Armor Up Buff, all hits gain +20% Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 85% chance to inflict a 2.5 second Stun Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack has a 85% chance to inflict a Concussion Debuff, reducing Ability Accuracy by 85% for 13 seconds. The Potency of this effect is affected by Class relationships.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This Attack has an 85% chance to inflict up to Two 5 second Stun Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ragin' Cajun
content: Prowess Buffs now also grant Gambit +[44.72 - 145.01] Critical Damage Rating each.
Additionally, his Flak Jacket is upgraded to allow it to absorb an additional [26,687.8] attack damage before breaking.
